---
title: "Python Naming Conventions"
format:
  typst:
    fontsize: 10pt
---

+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Convention                           | Typical Python use               | Example / well-known Python projects         |
+======================================+==================================+==============================================+
| PascalCase / CapWords                | Classes, exceptions, type names. | Python stdlib style; Django model/form/view  |
|                                      |                                  | classes; pandas `DataFrame`; scikit-learn    |
|                                      |                                  | estimators.                                  |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| camelCase / lowerCamelCase           | Uncommon in idiomatic Python;    | Python wrappers around JavaScript, JSON, or  |
|                                      | mainly used to mirror external   | cloud APIs may preserve upstream camelCase   |
|                                      | APIs.                            | fields.                                      |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `snake_case`                         | Functions, methods, variables,   | Python stdlib, NumPy, pandas, Django, Flask, |
|                                      | module names.                    | Requests, pytest.                            |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`               | Constants, environment           | Django settings; Flask config keys; many     |
|                                      | variables, config flags.         | stdlib constants.                            |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `kebab-case` / `dash-case`           | CLI commands, package            | scikit-learn, python-dateutil, pip-tools;    |
|                                      | distribution names, URLs, docs   | common for PyPI distribution names.          |
|                                      | slugs. Not valid as a Python     |                                              |
|                                      | identifier.                      |                                              |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `dot.case`                           | Namespaces, config keys, logger  | `logging.getLogger(__name__)`; dotted        |
|                                      | names, package-like paths.       | packages such as `zope.interface`.           |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `path/case`                          | File paths, package directories, | Django app paths; Flask route paths; general |
|                                      | web routes.                      | package layouts.                             |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `test_` prefix                       | Test files, test functions, test | pytest discovery: `test_*.py`, `*_test.py`,  |
|                                      | methods.                         | `test_` functions, `Test` classes.           |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `_leading_underscore`                | Internal/private-by-convention   | Used throughout the stdlib and most large    |
|                                      | names.                           | Python libraries.                            |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `__dunder__`                         | Python special methods and       | `__init__`, `__repr__`, `__iter__`,          |
|                                      | protocol hooks.                  | `__enter__`; core Python data model.         |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| `__leading_double_underscore`        | Name-mangled class internals to  | Used selectively inside classes; defined by  |
|                                      | reduce subclass collisions.      | Python language behavior.                    |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+
| Spaced Title Case                    | Human-facing titles, docs        | Sphinx, MkDocs, Read the Docs pages; not     |
|                                      | headings, UI labels.             | usually code identifiers.                    |
+--------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------+

**Core rule:** PEP 8 favors CapWords for classes, `snake_case` for functions/variables, and `UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES` for constants.
